newsitem.title: UK: LME copper touch stronger in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper touch stronger in late trading.

text.p: LME copper was slightly firmer in late inter-office trading on Thursday evening, probing back above the $2,250 level.
At 1900 GMT, three months copper was indicated at $2,251/54 after briefing bumping up to $2,255/60. This compares to a $2,248 afternoon kerb close.
Copper is expected to consolidate after recent gains failed to provide enough momentum to break $2,300. Initial support was seen at $2,230, with resistance around $2,280.
The other metals were little changed.
